summary: Two-part master implementation plan for Kaalyuga: Part 1 fixes every critical gameplay, shader, Susanoo, enemy AI, Temple Guardian, Dundubhi grounding, Hub NPC dialogue, instant local GLB loading, Chamber 4 OOM crash, and full GitHub audio wiring issue; Part 2 transforms the game into a true 2026 AAA 3D sculpted-arena action-RPG with dynamic cinematic boss camera, unified bright anime ink-cel shaders, lethal 3D elemental VFX, and dynamic orchestral audio.
